premise: What if all electronics stopped working?
hook:
What if all electronics
stopped working?
final_caption:
And your phone?
Just a very nice rock.

stages.label: Blackout
captions:
Every screen, light and engine
dies. All at once.

Every car on the road
coasts to a stop.

stages.label: Dead silence
captions:
No calls. No 911. No internet.
Nobody knows what happened.

With every light gone, the
Milky Way appears over the city.

stages.label: No water
captions:
The taps run dry.
Water pumps need power.

Morning comes.
No alarms. No news.

stages.label: Spoiling
captions:
Every fridge is warm.
Food starts to spoil.

stages.label: Exodus
captions:
Cities empty out.
People head for farmland.

stages.label: Overgrown
captions:
Weeds split the asphalt.
Rust eats the cars.

stages.label: Gone wild
captions:
Within a year, nature starts
taking the streets back.

stages.label: Forest city
captions:
After 10 years, young trees
tower over the cars.

title: What If All Electronics Stopped Working? ⚡
